verdict.rationale: Maritime runs agents in micro-VMs that sleep when idle and wake automatically, so cold-start latency is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents any wake or cold-start time. The 'under 5 minutes' figure refers to deploying a first agent, and the 'react in milliseconds' line describes the paid Always-on add-on, which implies sleeping agents do not wake that fast.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts
